title: Standard UAE shipping
text: DemoCart ships within the UAE only. Standard shipping takes 2 to 4 business days after dispatch. Delivery costs AED 15 for baskets below AED 150. Shipping is free for baskets of AED 150 or more.

title: Express shipping
text: Express shipping is available in selected UAE areas for AED 30 and normally arrives on the next business day after dispatch.

title: Standard returns
text: Most unused items may be returned within 14 days of delivery with original packaging. Personalised items and opened hygiene-sensitive products are excluded.

title: Return collection fees
text: Return collection is free for defective or incorrect items. A AED 10 collection fee applies to change-of-mind returns.
